shipped_summary: v3.12.0 — Money Finder (G11) and the Evaluator ladder (G12) shipped end-to-end on 2026-09-10, then hardened through eighteen review-fix-deploy cycles on 2026-09-11 (S6–S18).

Money Finder — 5-item public nav with 'Do you need money?', /funding intake → free preview → A$3 report (3 credits or plan), 56 grants + 199 programs as free directories with enriched detail pages, a public sample report, application drafts for grants and 15 programs, Founder Radar alerts bundled into Starter with activation nudges and a weekly refresh cron.

Evaluators — Scout A$79 / Firm A$149 / Program A$349 live with Stripe, card-required 7-day trial with one included Trust BizReport, 'Startups I am evaluating', batch scoring with cohort CSV and sponsor/LP report, weekly progress radar, activation checklist, investor 'Let matching founders see me' opt-in.

Security — atomic credit spend, spend-before-run on paid work, SSRF guard on catalogue fetches, constant-time secrets on every cron and internal route, edge CSRF gate for cookie-authenticated API mutations, member-aware project access with role enforcement (co-founder sharing works; two IDORs closed).

Quality — ESLint errors 271 → 0, accessibility fixes across the new UI, SEO sweep of 163 public pages (titles, OG, JSON-LD, sitemap of 252 funding pages), lean grouped directories (1.28 MB → ~390 KB), hourly cached catalogue reads, Gate-12 smoke extended to the new surfaces.

Compliance — privacy policy v2.2 covering Money Finder intake, evaluator-entered startup data, discoverability and retention, with a weekly retention sweep that mirrors the policy table (parity-tested).

Docs — generated phase×tier unlock matrix at /docs/unlocks, traction kit (angel groups, accelerator pilots, ProductHunt) under docs/marketing, roadmap-v2 reconciled against the codebase (25 shipped / 28 partial / 8 open).
notes: Every phase followed deploy → verify live → post-ship review → fix → deploy; nine reviews under docs/plans/reviews/. Two things the reviews caught that tests did not: a client component reaching server-only code through a dynamic import (build gate), and a viewer role reaching owner data through routes the feature had not converted (access review).
